-- Typed request and runner/service state.
import Json (..)
pub type StepDefinition = StepDefinition {
  id: String,
  needs: List(String),
  amount: Int,
  failures: Int
}

pub type Checkpoint = AfterBegin | AfterCall

pub type Command
  = Start(String)
  | Tick(Option(Checkpoint))
  | Advance(Int)
  | Observe
  | Crash
  | Restart
  | Cancel(String)
  | Claim(String)
  | Renew(String, Int)
  | Call(String, Int)
  | Deliver(Int)
  | CrashWorker(String)
  | RestartWorker(String)

pub type Workflow = Workflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(Command),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int,
  workers: Option(List(String)),
  lease_duration: Int
}

pub type StepStatus = Pending | Running | Succeeded | Failed | Blocked | Cancelled deriving (Eq)
pub type RunStatus = Active | SucceededRun | FailedRun | Failing | Cancelling | CancelledRun deriving (Eq)

pub type StepState = StepState {
  id: String,
  status: StepStatus,
  attempts: Int,
  ready_at: Int,
  lease: Option(Lease)
}

pub type Lease = Lease { worker: String, ticket: Int, expires: Int }
pub type WorkerState = WorkerState { id: String, up: Bool }
pub type TicketState = TicketState { ticket: Int, worker: String, run_id: String, step_id: String, attempt: Int, kind: CallKind, response: Option(CallOutcome), delivered: Bool }

pub type RunState = RunState {
  id: String,
  status: RunStatus,
  cancel_requested: Bool,
  steps: List(StepState)
}

pub type ActionKey = ActionKey { run_id: String, step_id: String }
pub type CallKind = ExecuteCall | LookupCall deriving (Eq)
pub type CallOutcome = Applied | Replayed | Transient | Found | Missing deriving (Eq)
pub type ServiceCall = ServiceCall { worker: String, ticket: Int, kind: CallKind, key: ActionKey, attempt: Int, outcome: CallOutcome }
pub type Effect = Effect { key: ActionKey, amount: Int }
pub type MockService = MockService { calls: List(ServiceCall), effects: List(Effect) }

pub type Snapshot = Snapshot { now: Int, up: Bool, runs: List(RunState) }
pub type Simulator = Simulator {
  now: Int,
  up: Bool,
  runs: List(RunState),
  service: MockService,
  observations: List(Snapshot),
  workers: List(WorkerState),
  leased: Bool,
  results: List(Json),
  tickets: List(TicketState),
  next_ticket: Int
}

pub type Action = Action { run: RunState, step: StepState, definition: StepDefinition }
pub type ServiceResult = ServiceResult { service: MockService, outcome: CallOutcome }

pub fn time_limit() : Int = 2147483647

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

fn parse_workers(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(List(String)), String) =
  match find(\(p) -> fst(p) == "workers", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(_) =>
      let raw = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
      let names = parse_ids(raw)?
      Ok(Some(names))

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json, leased : Bool) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" && not(leased) then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif (op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart") && not(leased) then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          elif leased && (op == "crash" || op == "restart") then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then CrashWorker(w) else RestartWorker(w))
          elif leased && op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(Claim(w))
          elif leased && op == "renew" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let t = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Renew(w, t))
          elif leased && op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let t = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Call(w, t))
          elif leased && op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let t = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Deliver(t))
          elif leased && op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(Observe)
          elif leased && op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(Cancel(id))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json), leased : Bool) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x, leased)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest, leased)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

fn worker_mode(workers : Option(List(String))) : Bool =
  match workers of
    None => false
    Some(_) => true

fn valid_workers(workers : Option(List(String))) : Bool =
  match workers of
    None => true
    Some(ws) => not(is_nil(ws)) && unique(ws)

pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "workers", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let workers = parse_workers(obj)?
  let leased = worker_mode(workers)
  let _ = ensure(valid_workers(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands, leased)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  let lease_duration = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, workers = workers, lease_duration = lease_duration })

pub fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let version = integer(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"), 1, 1)?
  let _ = ensure(version == 1, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) =>
      let _ = ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")?
      parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: new_simulator
defs.source: fn new_simulator() : Simulator = Simulator { now = 0, up = true, runs = [], service = new_service(), observations = [], workers = [], leased = false, results = [], tickets = [], next_ticket = 1 }

defs.name: snapshot
defs.source: fn snapshot(sim : Simulator) : Snapshot = Snapshot { now = sim.now, up = sim.up, runs = sim.runs }

defs.name: new_step
defs.source: fn new_step(now : Int, d : StepDefinition) : StepState = StepState { id = d.id, status = Pending, attempts = 0, ready_at = now, lease = None }

defs.name: replace_step
defs.source: fn replace_step(run : RunState, replacement : StepState) : RunState = RunState { ..run, steps = map(\(s) -> if s.id == replacement.id then replacement else s, run.steps) }

defs.name: replace_run
defs.source: fn replace_run(sim : Simulator, replacement : RunState) : Simulator = Simulator { ..sim, runs = map(\(r) -> if r.id == replacement.id then replacement else r, sim.runs) }

fn definition_amount(defs : List(StepDefinition), id : String) : Int =
  match definition_for(defs, id) of
    Some(d) => d.amount
    None => 0

defs.source:
fn definition_failures(defs : List(StepDefinition), id : String) : Int =
  match definition_for(defs, id) of
    Some(d) => d.failures
    None => 0

defs.name: deps_done
defs.source: fn deps_done(run : RunState, d : StepDefinition) : Bool = all(\(dep) -> any(\(s) -> s.id == dep && s.status == Succeeded, run.steps), d.needs)

select_run
defs.source:
fn select_run(now : Int, inflight : Bool, runs : List(RunState), defs : List(StepDefinition)) : Option(Action) =
  match runs of
    Nil => None
    Cons(r, rest) => match select_step(now, inflight, r, r.steps, defs) of
      Some(a) => Some(a)
      None => select_run(now, inflight, rest, defs)

defs.name: select_action
defs.source:
fn select_action(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Option(Action) =
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(a) => Some(a)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)

defs.name: all_succeeded
defs.source: fn all_succeeded(xs : List(StepState)) : Bool = all(\(s) -> s.status == Succeeded, xs)

defs.name: block_pending
defs.source: fn block_pending(run : RunState) : RunState = RunState { ..run, steps = map(\(s) -> if s.status == Pending then StepState { ..s, status = Blocked } else s, run.steps) }

defs.name: finish_success
defs.source: fn finish_success(run : RunState) : RunState = if all_succeeded(run.steps) then RunState { ..run, status = SucceededRun } else run

tick
cancel_run
apply_command
defs.source:
fn apply_command(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, command : Command) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match command of
    Observe => Ok(Simulator { ..sim, observations = append(sim.observations, [snapshot(sim)]) })
    Advance(by) => if sim.now + by > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, now = sim.now + by })
    Crash => if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = false })
    Restart => if sim.up then Err("PROCESS_UP") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = true })
    Start(id) => if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN") elif any(\(r) -> r.id == id, sim.runs) then Err("DUPLICATE_RUN") else
      Ok(Simulator { ..sim, runs = append(sim.runs, [RunState { id = id, status = Active, cancel_requested = false, steps = map(\(d) -> new_step(sim.now, d), workflow.steps) }]) })
    Cancel(id) => if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN") else cancel_run(sim, id)
    Tick(cp) => tick(sim, workflow, cp)
    Claim(_) => Err("UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
    Renew(_, _) => Err("UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
    Call(_, _) => Err("UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
    Deliver(_) => Err("UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
    CrashWorker(_) => Err("UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
    RestartWorker(_) => Err("UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")

defs.name: run_commands
defs.source:
fn run_commands(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, commands : List(Command)) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match commands of
    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(c, rest) =>
      let next = apply_command(sim, workflow, c)?
      run_commands(next, workflow, rest)

defs.name: simulate
defs.source: fn simulate(workflow : Workflow) : Result(Simulator, String) = run_commands(new_simulator(), workflow, workflow.commands)

defs.name: worker_exists
defs.source: fn worker_exists(xs : List(WorkerState), id : String) : Bool = any(\(w) -> w.id == id, xs)

defs.name: worker_up
defs.source: fn worker_up(xs : List(WorkerState), id : String) : Bool = any(\(w) -> w.id == id && w.up, xs)

defs.name: set_worker
defs.source: fn set_worker(xs : List(WorkerState), id : String, up : Bool) : List(WorkerState) = map(\(w) -> if w.id == id then WorkerState { ..w, up = up } else w, xs)

defs.name: live_lease
defs.source:
fn live_lease(lease : Option(Lease), now : Int) : Bool =
  match lease of
    None => false
    Some(x) => now < x.expires

defs.name: busy_step
defs.source:
fn busy_step(step : StepState, id : String, now : Int) : Bool =
  match step.lease of
    None => false
    Some(x) => x.worker == id && now < x.expires

defs.name: busy_worker
defs.source: fn busy_worker(runs : List(RunState), id : String, now : Int) : Bool = any(\(r) -> any(\(s) -> busy_step(s, id, now), r.steps), runs)

defs.name: find_ticket
defs.source: fn find_ticket(xs : List(TicketState), t : Int) : Option(TicketState) = find(\(x) -> x.ticket == t, xs)

defs.name: tag_last
defs.source:
fn tag_last(xs : List(ServiceCall), worker : String, ticket : Int) : List(ServiceCall) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Nil
    Cons(x, rest) => if is_nil(rest) then Cons(ServiceCall { ..x, worker = worker, ticket = ticket }, Nil) else Cons(x, tag_last(rest, worker, ticket))

defs.name: replace_ticket
defs.source: fn replace_ticket(xs : List(TicketState), t : TicketState) : List(TicketState) = map(\(x) -> if x.ticket == t.ticket then t else x, xs)

fn lease_step(run : RunState, step : StepState, worker : String, ticket : Int, expires : Int, begin : Bool) : RunState =
  replace_step(run, StepState { ..step, status = if begin then Running else step.status, attempts = if begin then step.attempts + 1 else step.attempts, lease = Some(Lease { worker = worker, ticket = ticket, expires = expires }) })

defs.source: fn drain_run(r : RunState, now : Int, current : String) : RunState = RunState { ..r, status = Failing, steps = map(\(s) -> if s.id == current then s else if s.status == Pending then StepState { ..s, status = Blocked } else expire_step(s, now), r.steps) }

defs.name: leased_commands
defs.source:
fn leased_commands(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, commands : List(Command)) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match commands of
    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(c, rest) =>
      let step = match c of
        Claim(w) => claim(sim, workflow, w)
        Call(w, t) => call_ticket(sim, workflow, w, t)
        Observe => Ok(leased_observe(sim))
        CrashWorker(w) => if not(worker_exists(sim.workers, w)) then Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER") elif not(worker_up(sim.workers, w)) then Err("WORKER_DOWN") else Ok(add_result(Simulator { ..sim, workers = set_worker(sim.workers, w, false) }, JNull))
        RestartWorker(w) => if not(worker_exists(sim.workers, w)) then Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER") elif worker_up(sim.workers, w) then Err("WORKER_UP") else Ok(add_result(Simulator { ..sim, workers = set_worker(sim.workers, w, true) }, JNull))
        Renew(w, t) => renew_ticket(sim, workflow, w, t)
        Deliver(t) => commit_ticket(sim, workflow, t)
        Cancel(id) =>
          let x = apply_command(sim, workflow, Cancel(id))?
          Ok(add_result(if cancel_was_requested(sim, id) then x else expire_cancel(x, id), JNull))
        _ =>
          let x = apply_command(sim, workflow, c)?
          Ok(add_result(x, JNull))
      let next = step?
      leased_commands(next, workflow, rest)

defs.name: commit_ticket
defs.source:
fn commit_ticket(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, n : Int) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match find_ticket(sim.tickets, n) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(t) => if t.delivered then Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))])))
      elif not(worker_up(sim.workers, t.worker)) then Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))])))
      else match find(\(r) -> r.id == t.run_id, sim.runs) of
        None => Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))])))
        Some(r) => match find(\(s) -> s.id == t.step_id, r.steps) of
          None => Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))])))
          Some(s) => match s.lease of
            None => Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))])))
            Some(l) => if l.ticket /= n || sim.now >= l.expires then Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))]))) else
              match t.response of
                None => Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("committed", JBool(false))])))
                Some(o) =>
                  let ns = if o == Transient && s.attempts < workflow.max_attempts then StepState { ..s, status = Pending, ready_at = sim.now + workflow.retry_delay, lease = None } elif o == Transient then StepState { ..s, status = Failed, lease = None } else if t.kind == LookupCall && o == Missing then StepState { ..s, status = Cancelled, lease = None } else StepState { ..s, status = Succeeded, lease = None }
                  let nr = if t.kind == LookupCall then RunState { ..replace_step(r, ns), status = if r.status == Failing then FailedRun else CancelledRun } elif o == Transient && s.attempts >= workflow.max_attempts then drain_run(replace_step(r, ns), sim.now, t.step_id) else finish_success(replace_step(r, ns))
                  let nt = TicketState { ..t, delivered = true }
                  Ok(add_result(Simulator { ..replace_run(Simulator { ..sim, tickets = replace_ticket(sim.tickets, nt) }, nr), tickets = replace_ticket(sim.tickets, nt) }, JObj([("committed", JBool(true))])))

defs.name: renew_ticket
defs.source:
fn renew_ticket(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, worker : String, n : Int) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  if not(worker_exists(sim.workers, worker)) then Err("UNKNOWN_WORKER")
  elif not(worker_up(sim.workers, worker)) then Err("WORKER_DOWN")
  else match find_ticket(sim.tickets, n) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(t) => if t.worker /= worker then Err("WRONG_WORKER") else
      match find(\(r) -> r.id == t.run_id, sim.runs) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
        Some(r) => match find(\(s) -> s.id == t.step_id, r.steps) of
          None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
          Some(s) => match s.lease of
            None => Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("renewed", JBool(false))])))
            Some(l) => if l.ticket /= n || sim.now >= l.expires then Ok(add_result(sim, JObj([("renewed", JBool(false))]))) else
              if sim.now + workflow.lease_duration > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW") else
                Ok(add_result(replace_run(sim, replace_step(r, StepState { ..s, lease = Some(Lease { ..l, expires = sim.now + workflow.lease_duration }) })), JObj([("renewed", JBool(true))])))

fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: parse_step

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

defs.name: parse_checkpoint
parse_command
defs.source:
fn parse_command(raw : Json, leased : Bool) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" && not(leased) then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif (op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart") && not(leased) then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          elif leased && (op == "crash" || op == "restart") then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then CrashWorker(w) else RestartWorker(w))
          elif leased && op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(Claim(w))
          elif leased && op == "renew" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let t = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Renew(w, t))
          elif leased && op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let w = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let t = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Call(w, t))
          elif leased && op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let t = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(Deliver(t))
          elif leased && op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(Observe)
          elif leased && op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(Cancel(id))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

    Cons(x, rest) =>

      let commands = parse_commands(rest, leased)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

defs.name: parse_workflow
defs.source:
fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "workers", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let workers = parse_workers(obj)?
  let leased = worker_mode(workers)
  let _ = ensure(valid_workers(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands, leased)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  let lease_duration = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, workers = workers, lease_duration = lease_duration })

defs.name: parse_request
defs.source:
fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let version = integer(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"), 1, 1)?
  let _ = ensure(version == 1, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) =>
      let _ = ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")?
      parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: handle_request
defs.source:
fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(_) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  let workflow = parse_request(request)?
  simulate(workflow)
